data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: exhibition
sections.summary: A public display of art, objects, or information for people to view.

senses.definition: a public display of works of art, historical objects, or other items for people to look at
examples: The museum is hosting a photography exhibition this month.

answers.answer: The art exhibition opens tomorrow.
The exhibition of art opens tomorrow.
An exhibition is a live band.

sections.question: film
sections.summary: A story or event recorded as a moving image, shown in a cinema or on television.

senses.definition: a story or sequence of events recorded as moving images and shown in a cinema or on television
examples: The film was so exciting that nobody wanted it to end.

answers.answer: We watched a film at the cinema.
We watched film at cinema.
A film is a theatre stage.

sections.question: free time
sections.summary: Time when you are not working or studying and can do what you enjoy.

senses.definition: time when you are not working, studying, or occupied with duties, and are free to do what you enjoy
examples: She uses her free time to learn new languages.

answers.answer: I read books in my free time.
I read books at my free time.
Free time is a public museum.

sections.question: gallery
sections.summary: A room or building where works of art are displayed or sold.

senses.definition: a room or building in which works of art are displayed for the public to see, or offered for sale
examples: The gallery near the city centre has some beautiful sculptures.

answers.answer: The gallery displays modern art.
The gallery shows a modern arts.
A gallery is a sports activity.

sections.question: game
sections.summary: An activity or contest with rules, played for fun or competition.

senses.definition: an activity or contest with rules that is played for fun, competition, or entertainment
examples: A board game is a great way to spend an evening with family.

answers.answer: They played a game of chess.
They played game of chess.
A game is a music performance.

sections.question: hobby
sections.summary: An activity that someone does regularly in their spare time for enjoyment.

senses.definition: an activity that someone does regularly for enjoyment during their spare time, not as a job
examples: His hobby is making model aeroplanes out of wood.

answers.answer: Photography is her favourite hobby.
Photography is her favourite hobbying.
A hobby is a university degree.

sections.question: leisure
sections.summary: Time when you are free from work or duties and can relax and enjoy yourself.

senses.definition: time when you are free from work or duties and can relax, pursue hobbies, or enjoy activities
examples: People with active leisure pursuits tend to be happier and healthier.

answers.answer: He spends his leisure time reading.
He spends his leisure times reading.
Leisure is a type of ticket.

sections.question: museum
sections.summary: A building where important objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest are kept and displayed.

senses.definition: a building where objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest are collected, displayed, and preserved for the public
examples: The natural history museum has fascinating dinosaur exhibits.

answers.answer: We visited the museum on Sunday.
We visited museum on Sunday.
A museum is a musical instrument.

sections.question: performance
sections.summary: An act of performing a play, concert, or other form of entertainment before an audience.

senses.definition: an act of performing a play, concert, or other entertainment before an audience; also how well someone does something
examples: The dance performance received a standing ovation from the crowd.

answers.answer: Her performance was excellent.
Her performance was very success.
A performance is a cinema building.

sections.question: play
sections.summary: A piece of writing performed on stage by actors, usually in a theatre.

senses.definition: a piece of dramatic writing performed on stage by actors, usually in a theatre
examples: The school's end-of-year play was a huge success.

answers.answer: We saw a play at the theatre.
We saw play at theatre.
